findings.description: The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Objects stored in this reports archive are not explicitly protected with a customer-managed or bucket-enforced encryption setting.

The bucket enables versioning and access logging but does not configure server-side encryption. Model artifacts and their retained versions are not explicitly protected at rest.
The bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Runbook content is not explicitly protected through bucket-level encryption or a KMS key.
